subject: Physics
countingNotes: The13 assessment-command rows (6legacy+7September) were missed by the original name/rule/definition heuristic; they are counted separately and do not enlarge the75 physical-science headwords. Grouped slash labels are not falsely counted as one unique verb.
The two shared states-thermal mock definitionReviews repeat Heat and Temperature; they are separate from the87legacy+20nuclear catalogue and add zero distinct headwords.
Visual coverage counts are numbers of definition records mapped to a figure/model, not numbers of distinct images. One image may support multiple records.

Direct diagram counts mean a core relation or explicit example is depicted, not that every clause/model limit is illustrated. Context-only or partial combined-concept mappings are listed in noDefinitionFigure and excluded from direct counts.
A term is counted once by explicit glossary headword, not twice for EN and RU and not again when repeated in a concept card, lesson or question.
A concept or extension card may explain several scientific ideas.107 counts cards, not an invented count of atomic scientific concepts.
Only one simulation overview happened to enter the original82-name inventory. All25 simulation descriptions are now enumerated separately; none is added to the75 explicit headwords.
The174 repeat records are bilingual content objects, not174 additional terms; multiplying by two would count language variants rather than new concepts.
Direct RU support means the read Russian text supports the core concept. It does not mean literal translation or full provenance of every model limit/example.
No newly claimed Russian verification for the EN-based rows.

Some useful visuals are elsewhere on the topic/lesson rather than inside the term card. Context-only and partial combined-concept visuals are identified in noDefinitionFigure and excluded from the direct figure count.
No claim that all original source statements are current or flawless: obsolete nuclear census/neutrino-mass statements and unrelated historical risk thresholds were not adopted.
This final pass is a source/count/diagram reconciliation. BrowserQA is recorded separately; it is not repeated here.
